headline: VIFC-HCMC holds consultation meeting on draft resolution on issuing municipal and project bonds
summary: The VIFC Management Authority in Ho Chi Minh City held a consultation on a draft resolution regulating municipal and project bond issuance. The bonds would mobilise capital for key city projects.
why: Municipal and project bonds are debt instruments used by local governments and projects to raise capital. A regulatory framework can open new fixed-income supply in Vietnam.
